final: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan) SELECT timespan, order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () - 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM counts
